summary: Injured backcountry skier off Rollins Pass in Gilpin County (2018-03)
notes: ART mission 2018-03. Cause of injury not stated. | Run-595 merge: Mountain-Ear 'Risky rescue ends well' (parent-opened) confirms the 11:40 Sunday call, Forest Lakes backcountry, 70-mph gusts grounding the helicopter, snowcat turned back at Yankee Doodle Lake, and sled evacuation to St. Anthony's ~9:30 p.m.; Alpine led the operation.
